subject: Metric versus imperial overall dimensions
ruling: Use the manufacturer metric listing, 790 x 160 x 60 mm, as the declared display envelope. Do not average or claim the two listings agree. No physical specimen was measured.

subject: Nominal depth list is not a numbered position map
ruling: Keep stable positional IDs edge-upper/edge-middle/edge-lower. Assign 10/15/20 mm top-to-bottom as a photo-inferred display interpretation of the increasing visible ledge reach. publishedDepthMm is null for each individual hold; the unnumbered manufacturer family remains separate. No measured usable flat depth is claimed.

subject: Reference-image provenance
ruling: Accept these user-supplied images as the requested Long references in conversation context. Preserve the exact uploaded bytes and identifiers. Do not claim independently downloaded manufacturer-original bytes or a cryptographic match to the inaccessible CDN.

subject: Rough molded rear surface versus clean display geometry
ruling: Retain the two cavities, central spine, bosses and longitudinal inner relief. Omit unmeasured fine resin/fiber wrinkles rather than invent a scanned texture or copy their shading into the material. Internal contour and 6 mm minimum modeled wall guard are display choices, not tested structural design.
